title: AuroraJobs
summary: A full stack job board built with Ruby on Rails: job search, alerts and posting for companies. A complete product, from database to deployment.
problem: Generalist job boards mix everything with everything. AuroraJobs explored a more focused space, with careful search and useful alerts.
audience: People looking for a job and companies posting openings.
role: Full Stack Developer: the complete product in Ruby on Rails, working close to product decisions.
responsibilities: Full product development: models, search, email alerts, company dashboard.
Design and implementation of the job search system.
Deployment, monitoring and running it in production.
Product decisions alongside the team: what to build and what to drop.
decisions: Monolithic Rails with Hotwire: development speed over sophisticated architecture.
Search as the product's centerpiece, not an added filter.
Email alerts as the main channel to bring users back.
outcomes: A complete product running in production.
The experience that consolidated my full stack years and how I work with product.
